title: Off-chain dispute-resolution jurisdiction
description: Three-layer dispute resolution. Layer 1 (kernel mechanisms — asymmetric bonding + buyer dominance) is always active and not encoded here. Layer 2 (Kleros — decentralized off-chain arbitration) is captured by `klerosCourt` + `klerosMinJurors`; Figaro's preferred default. Layer 3 (state / ADR / traditional jurisdictions) is captured by `applicableLaw` + `forum` + `language`. At least one of `klerosCourt` or `applicableLaw` must be set when this clause is included.

fields.name: klerosCourt
fields.description: Kleros subcourt for layer-2 ODR. general = catch-all; blockchain-nontechnical / blockchain-technical = on-chain-agreement disputes; english-language = disputes hinging on English-language interpretation.

fields.name: klerosMinJurors
fields.description: Minimum jurors for the Kleros subcourt. Kleros default is 3.

fields.name: applicableLaw
fields.description: Identifier for the body of law that governs the contract at layer 3. Conventionally an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'US', 'NL', 'JP'), optionally with ISO 3166-2 subdivision (e.g., 'US-CA', 'CA-ON'). 'EU' for European Union law. 'INTL' for international/treaty law. Free-form for non-state legal orders (e.g., 'Sharia', 'ICANN-UDRP').

fields.name: forum
fields.description: Named adjudication venue at layer 3 (e.g., 'JAMS-arbitration', 'AAA-arbitration', 'ICC-arbitration', 'us-federal-court', 'small-claims-court'). Empty means: courts of competent jurisdiction within applicableLaw.

fields.name: language
fields.description: ISO 639-1 / 639-2 language code for layer-3 adjudication proceedings. E.g., 'en', 'fr', 'zh', 'ar'. Empty means: official language of the forum.
